commands.command: set -eu; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0fe28cc50c0cb2aab19af31aaf4a40a76aff3205"; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -1); test -n "$SERIAL"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-auth.xml >/dev/null; BOUNDS=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/blueeye-auth.xml | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); ns=[x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("resource-id")=="com.google.android.gms:id/account_name"]; assert len(ns)>=2, f"expected >=2 accounts, got {len(ns)}"; print(ns[1].attrib["bounds"])'); XY=$(printf '%s' "$BOUNDS" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",sys.stdin.read()))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY; echo "secondary_bounds=$BOUNDS tap=$1,$2"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 2; echo '--- resumed ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | head -5 || true; echo '--- next UI ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-consent.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/blueeye-consent.xml 2>/dev/null | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -E 'text=|content-desc=' | head -140 || true
